units.source_text: 然而，照片上名人的感情渗透了我的心。

en.t: Yet the emotion of the master in the photograph seeped into my heart.

units.source_text: 也许是名人的遗容流露出感情了。

en.t: Perhaps the master's death mask had begun to reveal emotion.

units.source_text: 的确，那副遗容是流露了感情的。

en.t: Indeed, that face of the dead did show emotion.

units.source_text: 可是这位故人已经没有感情了。

en.t: But this departed man no longer had any feelings.

units.source_text: 想到这里，我就觉得这张照片不是活的也不是死的，拍得就像活人酣睡似的。

en.t: Thinking this, I felt that the photograph was neither alive nor dead, and that it had been taken as if a living person were sleeping soundly.

units.source_text: 但是，我并不是这个意思。

en.t: But that is not quite what I mean.

units.source_text: 即使把它看作遗容照，也使人觉得照片里存在着不是活也不是死的东西。

en.t: Even if one regards it as a photograph of the deceased, it still makes one feel that something neither alive nor dead exists within the picture.

units.source_text: 大概是因为如实拍下了刚刚还活着的脸的缘故。

en.t: It was probably because it had faithfully captured a face that had been alive only moments before.

units.source_text: 这张脸令人回想起名人生前的许多往事。

en.t: This face called to mind many things from the master's life.

units.source_text: 或许因为这不是遗容本身，而是遗容照片。

en.t: Perhaps it was because this was not the death mask itself, but a photograph of it.

units.source_text: 显然，遗容的照片要比遗容清晰得多，这也很奇怪。

en.t: Clearly, the photograph of the dead face was far clearer than the face itself, and that too was strange.

units.source_text: 我甚至想，这张照片是不是什么不能看的秘密的象征呢。

en.t: I even wondered whether this photograph might be the symbol of some secret that should not be seen.
